I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to pull in real‑time or future weather data directly. To get an hourly forecast for temperature, wind speed, and precipitation for the next 10 days at 37.8651 N, 119.5383 W (Yosemite National Park), you could use a weather service such as:

| Service | API / Endpoint | Key Data Fields |
|---------|----------------|-----------------|
| **OpenWeatherMap** | `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/onecall?lat=37.8651&lon=-119.5383&exclude=current,minutely,daily,alerts&units=metric&appid=YOUR_API_KEY` | `hourly.temp`, `hourly.wind_speed`, `hourly.pop` (probability of precipitation) |
| **NOAA Climate Data Online** | `https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/api/v2/` (requires token) | Hourly observations for temperature, wind speed, precipitation |
| **WeatherAPI.com** | `https://api.weatherapi.com/v1/forecast.json?key=YOUR_KEY&q=37.8651,-119.5383&days=10&aqi=no&alerts=no` | `forecast.forecastday[].hour[].temp_c`, `wind_kph`, `precip_mm` |

You would need to sign up for an API key, then make a request to the appropriate endpoint. The response will include an array of hourly data points for each of the next 10 days, from which you can extract temperature, wind speed, and precipitation.

If you’d like help constructing the exact request URL or parsing the JSON response, let me know!
